entities.summary: Jonas Martin Nordquist is a Swedish former professional ice hockey centre, who last played for EC KAC in Austrian Hockey League (EBEL). Nordquist was drafted by the Chicago Blackhawks in the 2nd round of the 2000 NHL Entry Draft. He played in three games in the 2006-07 season with the Blackhawks, recording 2 assists.
